description: Synthetic cn_a 5-minute bar fixtures for the pt-v1.2 paper-trade tests. Every file here is AUTHORED, not recorded from a provider: the live stk_mins probe (T1) supplied the SHAPE (49 raw rows per session = 09:30 opening-auction print + 48 continuous bars, labels are bar ENDS, volume in shares), and the prices are synthetic. Tests must never present these numbers as market data. sha256 is of the exact on-disk bytes; test_paper_trade_5m_golden.py re-verifies them and fails when a fixture changes without this manifest.

conventions.label_semantics: bar END in Asia/Shanghai wall clock (09:35 covers 09:30-09:35)
conventions.auction_row: the 09:30 row is the opening call-auction print and is excluded from the matched session bar
conventions.volume_unit: shares (5m caliber, T1) - the derived daily frame divides by 100 to reach lots
conventions.empty_day_sentinel: a header-only CSV is a zero-bar session, not a missing fixture

fixtures.construction: 09:30 opening-auction print at 1418.00 (single price, matches the daily open); 48 continuous bars at 1419.00 with a 1421.00 high at 10:05, a 1417.00 low at 11:00 and a 1420.00 close at 15:00; volume 120000 shares per continuous bar. Provides the previous close for the 2026-10-20 price-limit band and the carry-forward mark for the 2026-10-19 halt.

Header-only file: the documented zero-bar sentinel for a suspended session (T1: a suspended day is absent from BOTH the daily and the 5m endpoint). Readers must treat it as zero bars, never as a missing fixture.
09:30 opening-auction print at 1423.00 (single price, equals the daily open); 48 continuous bars at 1421.00 with a 1422.00 close at 15:00; volume 120000 shares per continuous bar.

Witness session for the halted-day case: 09:30 auction print at 10.00 plus 48 continuous bars around 10.00 (high 10.05 at 10:30, low 9.98 at 14:00, close 10.02 at 15:00), volume 500000 shares per continuous bar. Its presence keeps the 2026-10-19 whole-universe check from collapsing a one-symbol halt into PAPER_DATA_NOT_READY (D6).
